name: PageIntro
title: PageIntro
summary: The opening block of an inner page (eyebrow, headline, lead) and the matching section heading row with an eyebrow, h2 and a ghost "See all" link.
whenToUse: Page intro: top of every inner page (HD Radio, Publishing, About, FAQ, Give) where the home Hero would be too heavy.
Section heading row: above a grid or list section that has its own index page ("What we do", "Latest stories").
whenNotToUse: Do not use the page intro twice on one page.
Do not add a ghost link when there is nothing more to see.

props.name: eyebrow
props.description: Eyebrow label (programme or section name). Not a heading.

props.name: title
props.description: Headline, rendered as the page's single `<h1>` styled `.h2`. Wrap at most one word in `<span className="em">`.

props.name: actions
props.description: Optional buttons below the lead (a primary and a secondary `Button`).

variantNotes: Intro on light (default): `.em` shows the gradient marker. Inside `.sec-ink` the eyebrow, headline and lead switch to dark styles automatically.
Intro may add buttons below the lead (a `.btn-primary` and a `.btn-secondary`) on pages with one clear action.
Heading row: text left, ghost link aligned to the bottom right; on narrow screens the link wraps under the heading.
Ghost link hover: `--horizon-blue-dim`; the ↗ arrow nudges up-right.

states.universal: See rules/states.md for the seven required states and their hooks.

rules: Inner pages style their `<h1>` with `.h2`; only the home Hero uses `.h1` size.
Cap the intro at `--measure-reading` (760px) wide; it is built in to `.dp-intro`.
Keep 20px between eyebrow, headline and lead.
The heading-row link is `.btn-ghost`, never a filled button. Use ↗ when it opens another page; use no arrow for an in-page anchor.
Leave at least `--space-7` (48px) between the heading row and the content below.
do: Page intro: top of every inner page (HD Radio, Publishing, About, FAQ, Give) where the home Hero would be too heavy.
Section heading row: above a grid or list section that has its own index page ("What we do", "Latest stories").
Inner pages style their `<h1>` with `.h2`; only the home Hero uses `.h1` size.
Cap the intro at `--measure-reading` (760px) wide; it is built in to `.dp-intro`.
Keep 20px between eyebrow, headline and lead.
The heading-row link is `.btn-ghost`, never a filled button. Use ↗ when it opens another page; use no arrow for an in-page anchor.
Leave at least `--space-7` (48px) between the heading row and the content below.
dont: Do not use the page intro twice on one page.
Do not add a ghost link when there is nothing more to see.
accessibility: The intro headline is the page's single `<h1>`; section headings are `<h2>`.
The eyebrow is a label, not a heading; do not mark it up as `h*`.
Make the ghost link text specific when there are several on a page ("See all programmes ↗"), or add a `.dp-vh` suffix.
Ghost links keep the 44px `.btn` height for tap targets.
content: Eyebrow: the programme or section name ("HD Radio Broadcast", "What we do").
Headline: short and concrete, ending in a full stop: "Scripture on the airwaves."
Lead: one sentence on what the page offers.
